C1372.title: Shandong Qingdao Mnemonic Memory Theft Case: 107 BTC Stolen
C1372.summary: In July 2023, the defendant Zhang exploited the opportunity of assisting Feng with a digital wallet transaction. While Feng wrote down the 12-word mnemonic phrase, Zhang secretly memorized 11 complete words and the first letter of the remaining word, brute-forced the missing part that same night, gained control of the wallet, and transferred 107 BTC, cashing out over 660,000 RMB through a virtual-currency exchange. On April 28, 2025, the court convicted Zhang of theft and sentenced him to ten years and nine months in prison plus a 100,000 RMB fine; the second-instance ruling upheld the conviction.
